description: This is the entry point JavaScript file for a React-based frontend application. It sets up the React rendering process by importing necessary modules, including React, ReactDOM, CSS styles, and the main App component, then rendering the App within a StrictMode wrapper into the root DOM element.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root React DOM node for rendering the React application.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders React elements into the React root, displaying the App component within StrictMode.
